policy: keep original movement and online termination; rank actually observed historical endpoints using each visit prefix logit; charge full return path
label_scope: original instruction own goal distance <3m; not full instruction completion
training_budget: 1280 optimizer updates; same original path pool and group order. C3/M also use identical complete data; actual state counts across C1/C2/C3 may differ.
validation: separate full-split access must be registered after training; no automatic val execution
